question: What arises from mantra-fire burning?
premises: By that mantra-fire burning in body and eightfold city.
So from destruction of body-city-ego arises.
inference: Mantra-fire burning in body and eightfold city destroys ego and gives rise.
plain_english: By that mantra-fire burning in body and eightfold city, so from destruction of body-city-ego arises.
